title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Czinger 21C
description:
Two things about the Czinger 21C that most car fans do not know. First, much of this hypercar was designed to be made without the molds, dies and fixtures that normally shape a car. Second, the same car has taken the Laguna Seca production-car lap record three times, by a bigger margin each time. We checked both claims against the sources. Our sources are Wikipedia's page on the 21C, an engineering article from the American Society of Mechanical Engineers, a Backfire News report, GTPlanet, FastCar, Facfox and a Caltech-linked business magazine called CSQ. Where they disagree, and they disagree a lot, we show both numbers. Our own arithmetic is always labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
